visual_description: A high-tech handheld device resembling a bulky, futuristic camera with dual lenses and an integrated screen. It emits a visible grid of soft blue light patterns onto a dinosaur footprint in the rock. The screen shows a real-time 'heat map' of the 3D depth data being captured.

constraints.logic: Used for non-invasive data collection of surfaces.
constraints.background: Held by a technician over a horizontal rock slab with clear trackway impressions.
